title: Haalaama E Wonnde
intro: Limre yaltata ko e daartol ceningol, ina jogii kaawisaaji ɗi luulndii njuɓɓudi tago. Ooɗoo ruuhu ari ko e yamiroore Alla gooto, fawi jibinannde mum e tuumeede, yalti e oo aduna hade kaɓirɗe leydi waawde haɓɓude ɗum en. Daartol ngol ina yahra e ɓiɗɓe leɗɗe leslese haa e asamaan dow. Hol ɗum waawi wonde?
clues: Mi neldaama hono maande e yurmeende ummoraade e Alla feewde e 6i66e Israa’iila.
Gargol am wayi ko no ko adii — mi arii e tagoore nde e konngol diine ‘Be!’. tawa alaa baaba leydi.
Jibinannde am fotnoo ko fenaande bonnde, kono wahyu ceniɗo jippii ngam hollirde laaɓal maɓɓe e toownude darnde maɓɓe.
Ko mi cukalel jibinaaɗo, miɗo haawnii wonɓe e sara am ɓee, miɗo haalda laaɓɗo gila e ŋoral am ngam laaɓtinde innde jibinannde am.
E yamiroore Alla, mi mbayli nguurndam e loope ɗe ngalaa nguurndam, mi rokki wumɓe gite, mi sellini ñawu nguu e memoore am.
Mi ummiima haa asamaan hade bonannde meemde mi, mi hoota e oo aduna hade waktu cakkitiiɗo oo arde.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Ummitinaaɗo haa asamaan, maa artu ko adii ñalawma darnga
Wonti laamɗo jogiiɗo laamu e dow jinneeji, e yimɓe, e colli
Wuuri e ilam mawɗam e gooŋɗinɓe
Mahi suudu seniindu ndu to Makka
outcome.answer: Ummitinaaɗo haa asamaan, maa artu ko adii ñalawma darnga

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verse: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water. (23:50)
